room_rent.note: Policy wording does not specify a room rent cap or entitlement tier; room rent is listed as a covered inpatient expense but no limit or room category is stated.

icu.note: ICU is listed as a covered inpatient expense but no specific cap is mentioned.

copayment.note: No co-payment clause found in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: Maternity: Normal ₹15,000 / Caesarean ₹25,000 (incl. pre/post natal ₹1,500 & infant ₹2,000); Ambulance: ₹2,000/hospitalisation; Daily cash shared room: ₹500/day max ₹3,000; Daily cash child: ₹300/day max ₹9,000. Core inpatient treatment has no stated sub-limits.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 36 months of continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, calculus diseases, etc.) excluded for 24 months.

maternity.note: Normal delivery ₹15,000; Caesarean ₹25,000; pre/post natal ₹1,500; infant baby ₹2,000. Limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime. Spouse only under family floater. Does not dip into inpatient SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added each renewal irrespective of claims; maximum 50% of base SI. Outpatient Part A entitlement certificates carry forward at 50% if unused (one year only).

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Default 30 days; extended to 60 days if medical documents and hospitalisation details provided at least 5 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Default 60 days; extended to 90 days if pre-hospitalisation notice conditions met.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered under Part B.1.d).

domiciliary.note: Covered under Part B.1.e) if condition lasts at least 3 days and hospitalisation not possible.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered in AYUSH Hospital; OPD AYUSH not covered.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered; donor's pre/post-hospitalisation not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: No explicit mention of modern/robotic surgery cover or sub-limits in the policy wording.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses are explicitly excluded (Annexure I list); gloves, nebuliser kits, etc. listed as non-payable.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states coverage is only within India.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for non-monthly premium modes; 15 days for monthly instalment mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Stem cell harvesting, congenital external anomalies, sleep apnoea investigation, spinal manipulation, hearing aids, alopecia treatment, external prosthetics/devices, OPD treatment

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness lump sum (₹3,00,000, individual basis), Newborn baby cover
